variants.name: add-refuses-at-six
variants.why: Add note stays enabled; with six notes on the board pressing it adds nothing and a visible message says the maximum is six.

variants.name: repeated-moves-are-one-action
variants.why: Successive arrow keys on the same note are one Undo step, as a typing session is; moves of different notes stay separate actions.

variants.name: text-applied-with-button
variants.why: The Text field holds a draft that an Apply button commits to the selected note, instead of committing on every keystroke.

variants.name: export-in-textarea
variants.why: The Export preview dialog shows each note's text and coordinates as lines inside a read-only text area instead of a list.

variants.name: number-and-text-in-one
variants.why: A note renders its number and its text as one text ("#2 words") instead of two elements; the text is still literal.
